name: localops-guardian
description: Connect Codex to bounded LocalOps server status, checks, diagnostics, and dry-run recovery plans; the native pet remains a visual task-status entry point.

interface.shortDescription: Let Codex watch and explain your servers
interface.longDescription: Connects Codex tasks to the local-only LocalOps API. Codex can summarize current server health, run bounded single-host light checks, explain diagnostic evidence, and prepare non-executing recovery plans without arbitrary shell access. The native Codex pet only reflects the task lifecycle. Checks write local history but do not modify remote servers.
